```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(palmerpenguins)
devtools::load_all()
```


## 1. Helper Function Demonstration: `calculate_shares()`

Our custom helper function `calculate_shares()` rapidly aggregates categorical data and calculates percentage shares.

```{r helper-demo}
penguins %>% 
  calculate_shares(species)
```

## 2. Demonstrating the 5 Required Data Moves

### Step 2.1: `filter` & `mutate`
```{r move-filter-mutate}
penguins_clean <- penguins %>%
  filter(!is.na(body_mass_g), !is.na(sex)) %>%
  mutate(body_mass_kg = body_mass_g / 1000)
```

### Step 2.2: `group_by` & `summarise`
```{r move-groupby-summarise}
species_summary <- penguins_clean %>%
  group_by(species, island) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_mass_kg = round(mean(body_mass_kg), 2),
    avg_bill_len = round(mean(bill_length_mm), 2),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Step 2.3: `join`
```{r move-join}
island_info <- tibble::tibble(
  island = c("Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"),
  archipelago = c("Palmer Archipelago", "Palmer Archipelago", "Palmer Archipelago")
)

penguins_joined <- species_summary %>%
  left_join(island_info, by = "island")
```

### Step 2.4: `arrange`
```{r move-arrange}
penguins_final <- penguins_joined %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_mass_kg))

penguins_final
```

## 3. Custom Theme Demonstration: `theme_custom()`

```{r theme-demo, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
brand_colors <- c("#2B5C8F", "#E69F00", "#009E73")

ggplot(penguins_final, aes(x = reorder(species, -avg_mass_kg), y = avg_mass_kg, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brand_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Penguin Body Mass by Species",
    subtitle = "Clean layout styled with theme_custom()",
    x = "Penguin Species",
    y = "Average Body Mass (kg)",
    caption = "Data: palmerpenguins package | [www.yourwebsite.com](https://www.yourwebsite.com)"
  ) +
  theme_custom()
```
